title: Waves of democracy
description: Major surges of democracy in history
extract: In political science, the waves of democracy or waves of democratization are major surges of democracy that have occurred in history, in contrast with waves of autocracy or waves of autocratization, where democratic backsliding occurs. The third wave of autocratization is ongoing and began during the war on terror or Great Recession.
